name: diagnostics-capabilities
title: Capabilities, limits and extensions
summary: Version/limit/extension report; every limit checked against the spec minimum for the context version; meta-gl availability of every core entry point.
spec: ES 3.1 §20.x and ES 3.2 §21 Implementation Dependent tables

api.glGetString: VERSION/VENDOR/RENDERER/SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION equal meta-gl Capabilities; EXTENSIONS set equals glGetStringi set
api.glGetStringi: every index equals Capabilities::extensions[i]; NUM_EXTENSIONS index -> NULL + INVALID_VALUE
api.glGetIntegerv: ~100 implementation limits checked against per-version minimums
api.glGetInteger64v: MAX_ELEMENT_INDEX, MAX_UNIFORM_BLOCK_SIZE, MAX_SERVER_WAIT_TIMEOUT, MAX_SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCK_SIZE, combined uniform components
api.glGetFloatv: point/line width ranges contain 1.0, LOD bias, interpolation offsets
api.glClear: scissored clears draw the version strip (pixel-checked)

visual_review.notes: softpipe capture: bars ES2.0/3.0/3.1 green, ES3.2 gray, matching its native ES 3.1.
